raw_segments.text: Now, as I live, I will.
My nobler friends, I crave their pardons.
For the mutable, rank-scented many, let them regard me as I do not flatter, and therein
I say again, in soothing them we nourish, against our scent at the cockle of rebellion,
insolence, sedition, which we ourselves have ploughed for, sowed, and scattered by mingling
